open_points.subject: AuditRecord actor identity for an unmatched staff login failure
open_points.text: `actor_id: UUID | None` `[closed-choice: required unless system, except a staff.login_failed whose address matched no account]`
open_points.question: When a staff login fails because the submitted address matches no StaffAccount, must the AuditRecord use `actor_kind = staff` with `actor_id = None`, or `actor_kind = system` with `actor_id = None`?
options: Use `actor_kind = staff` to classify the attempted principal contour, with no actor identity.
Use `actor_kind = system` because no authenticated or matching staff principal exists.
open_points.default_guess: Use `actor_kind = staff` with `actor_id = None`, because otherwise the newly added exception to the ordinary actor-id rule is unnecessary.

witness.initial: The portal has an active staff account for alice@example.com and no account for nobody@example.com.
events: An unauthenticated caller attempts staff login as nobody@example.com with an invalid password.
The login use case appends the required `staff.login_failed` AuditRecord.
outcomes: The record has `actor_kind = staff` and `actor_id = None`.
The record has `actor_kind = system` and `actor_id = None`.
witness.observer: An audit reader or downstream audit processor sees a different actor classification for the same failed-login fact.
